<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>U-Vibe Pulse · Reporte Power BI</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#0A0F4A;--pn:#111a73;--pn2:#1A237E;--ln:#2d38ad;--tx:#fff;--mu:#a9b1ee;--lm:#B5F20D;--rd:#ff5d5d;--am:#ffc24d;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
:root[data-theme="light"]{color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:10px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);flex-wrap:wrap;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0d1470,var(--bg))}
.top img{height:34px}.top h1{font-size:1.15rem;margin:0;flex:1;min-width:180px}.top h1 b{color:var(--lm)}
.sl{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--mu)}
.ch{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--tx);border-radius:4px;padding:5px 12px;font:inherit;font-size:.78rem;cursor:pointer}.ch.on{background:var(--lm);color:#10155c;border-color:var(--lm);font-weight:700}
.pg{display:none;padding:14px 18px;max-width:1240px;margin:auto}.pg.on{display:block}
.g{display:grid;gap:12px}.k4{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr))}
.v{background:var(--pn);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:6px;padding:12px;min-width:0}
.v h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--mu);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.kp b{display:block;font-size:2.3rem;line-height:1.1;color:var(--lm);font-weight:700}.kp small{color:var(--mu);font-size:.72rem}
.r2{grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr}.r3{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr))}
.ph{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pn2);padding:0;min-height:260px}
.ph img{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;height:100%;max-width:60%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.ph div{position:relative;padding:16px;max-width:55%}.ph b{font-size:2.8rem;color:var(--lm);line-height:1}.ph p{margin:6px 0;font-size:.85rem}
.cols{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:190px}
.col{flex:1;min-width:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.col i{width:100%;background:#4f5bd5;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;min-height:2px;transition:height .45s,background .2s;position:relative}
.col:hover i{background:#8e98ff}.col.s i{background:var(--lm)}.col.m i{background:#4f5bd5;opacity:.35}
.col span{font-size:.58rem;color:var(--mu);margin-top:3px}
.col u{font-size:.55rem;color:var(--tx);text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:2px}
.hb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 46px;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:7px 0;font-size:.8rem}
.bar{height:12px;background:rgba(120,130,255,.18);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--lm);transition:width .6s}
.hb em{font-style:normal;text-align:right;font-weight:700}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.8rem}th{text-align:left;color:var(--mu);font-weight:600;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);cursor:pointer}td{padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,56,173,.5);vertical-align:top}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px}
.tg{font-size:.65rem;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:700}.A{background:var(--rd)}.Mm{background:var(--am);color:#222}.Bb{background:var(--lm);color:#10155c}
.gau{width:150px;display:block;margin:auto}
.web{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1A237E,#0c1263);border-radius:6px;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--ln)}
.cg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:10px}
.c{background:#fff;color:#1A237E;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;position:relative;transition:.3s}
.c h4{margin:4px 0}.c p{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:.78rem;color:#3d46a3}.c ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 6px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;font-size:.68rem}.c li{background:#e8ebff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px}
.c small{font-weight:700;font-size:.72rem}.c .m{height:6px;background:#dde0ff;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:3px}.c .m i{display:block;height:100%;background:#1A237E}
.c.f{opacity:.5;filter:grayscale(.6)}.c.f:after{content:"LLENO";position:absolute;top:10px;right:-5px;background:#d93a3a;color:#fff;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:800;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:5px 0 0 5px}.c.f .m i{background:#d93a3a}
.tabs{position:sticky;bottom:0;display:flex;gap:2px;overflow-x:auto;background:#070b38;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding:6px 10px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
.tabs button{background:transparent;color:var(--mu);border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;padding:8px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:.82rem;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.tabs button.on{color:var(--tx);border-color:var(--lm);background:var(--pn)}
.uvi{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#1A237E,#111a73);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:6px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:12px}
.uvi img{height:150px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .3s;animation:fl 3s ease-in-out infinite}.uvi img:hover{transform:rotate(-6deg) scale(1.06)}
@keyframes fl{50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
.bb{position:relative;background:#fff;color:#1A237E;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px;font-size:.9rem;max-width:560px}.bb:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-10px;top:40px;border:8px solid transparent;border-right-color:#fff;border-left:0}
.bb b{color:#1A237E}.bb button{margin-top:8px;background:#1A237E;color:#B5F20D;border:0;border-radius:99px;padding:5px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:.75rem;cursor:pointer}
@media(max-width:700px){.r2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ph div{max-width:60%}}
</style></head><body>
<div class="top"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Universidad Gerardo Barrios"><h1>U-VIBE <b>PULSE</b> · Reporte de uso, 13–30 oct 2026</h1><div class="sl">Tipo de evento: <span id="sl"></span> <button class="ch" id="rs">Borrar selección</button></div><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Semana U-Vibe" style="height:38px"></div>

<div class="pg on" id="p0"><div class="g k4" id="kp"></div>
<div class="g r2" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="v"><h3><span>Eventos por día · clic para filtrar</span><span id="sd"></span></h3><div class="cols" id="cd"></div></div>
<div class="v ph"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Estudiante U-Vibe"><div><b>92.2%</b><p>del uso ocurrió del 19 al 22 de octubre.</p><p>Pico: martes 20 con <b style="font-size:1.1rem">5,517</b> eventos, el 52% del total.</p></div></div></div>
<div class="g r2" style="margin-top:12px;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr"><div class="v"><h3>Eventos por hora del día</h3><div class="cols" id="ch" style="height:150px"></div></div><div class="v"><h3>Por día de la semana</h3><div id="wk"></div></div></div></div>

<div class="pg" id="p1"><div class="uvi"><img id="ui" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="U-vi, asistente virtual de Semana U-Vibe"><div class="bb"><div id="ub"></div><button id="un">Otro dato de U-vi</button></div></div><div class="g r3"><div class="v"><h3>Preguntas respondidas</h3><svg class="gau" viewBox="0 0 120 120"><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="none" stroke="#4f5bd5" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="14"/><circle id="ga" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="none" stroke="#B5F20D" stroke-width="14" stroke-dasharray="314" stroke-dashoffset="314" transform="rotate(-90 60 60)" style="transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.2s"/><text x="60" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">77.5%</text></svg><p style="text-align:center;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--mu)">789 de 1,018 · <b style="color:var(--lm)">229</b> sin respuesta</p></div>
<div class="v"><h3>Dónde falla el chat (sin respuesta)</h3><div id="fl"></div></div><div class="v"><h3>Lectura rápida</h3><p style="font-size:.85rem;color:var(--mu)">El 65.5% de lo no respondido es “otros temas”. Elegibilidad solo responde 2 de 10. Inscripción y Obligatorio superan 98%: ahí el chat funciona.</p></div></div>
<div class="v" style="margin-top:12px"><h3>Temas · clic en el encabezado para ordenar</h3><table id="ct"></table></div></div>

<div class="pg" id="p2"><div class="g r3"><div class="v"><h3>Programas y sedes filtrados</h3><div id="pr"></div></div><div class="v"><h3>Duración</h3><div id="du"></div><h3 style="margin-top:12px">Día</h3><div id="dd"></div></div><div class="v"><h3>Top 10 búsquedas escritas</h3><div id="tp"></div><p style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--mu)">78% usó filtros (5,181) · 22% escribió (1,465)</p></div></div></div>

<div class="pg" id="p3"><div class="v"><h3>Plan de acción para la próxima edición</h3><table id="ac"></table></div>
<div class="v" style="margin-top:12px"><h3>Correcciones a la presentación actual</h3><table id="pp"></table></div></div>
